CIA Report of Unidentified Flying Objects, 19 January – 15 May 1954

#ufotwitter #ufo #UFOx 

UFO sighting reports from early 1954. It summarizes incidents reported by military personnel, civilians, and observers in different locations during that period.

The report is essentially a collection of UFO sighting reports from early 1954. It summarizes incidents reported by military personnel, civilians, and observers in different locations during that period.

Key characteristics of the document:

Covers sightings between 19 January and 15 May 1954.

Describes objects seen in the sky with unusual movement, lights, or shapes.

Some sightings were made by pilots or radar observers, others by civilians.

Many reports mention:

bright lights

disc-like or circular objects

high speed or sudden direction changes

The document does not conclude they are extraterrestrial. It’s just a raw intelligence report compiling sightings.

🛸 Most Interesting Cases in the CIA Document

🇩🇿 Algeria — Multi-city UFO with smoke trails

Date: 18 January 1954
Locations: Saint-Arnaud and Sétif
Witnesses reported several unusual events in the same afternoon:

An object leaving two white smoke trails made a huge circular path over Saint-Arnaud.

Military officers nearby said they heard a strange sound from the object.

Later, people in Sétif saw an object with bluish smoke trails that moved slowly, circled the town, then suddenly accelerated away.

That same day, observers also reported a large luminous rectangular object flying in a straight path for over 30 minutes.

Why this case stands out:

Multiple towns reported sightings on the same day.

Different shapes were described (cigar-like and rectangular).

🇫🇷 France — Cone-shaped object with navigation lights

Date: 15 April 1954
Location: Saint-Mesant (Corrèze)
Two residents saw:

an elongated cone-shaped object

with red and green lights at its base

flying high altitude from northwest to southwest.

Why it’s interesting:

Red and green lights resemble aircraft navigation lights, but the cone shape did not match known aircraft reported in newspapers at the time.

🇫🇷 France / 🇪🇸 Spain border — Fast “cigar-shaped” object

Date: 26 April 1954
Location: Near Sare in the Pyrenees
A group of walkers saw:

a cigar-shaped flying object

moving at about 2,000 meters altitude

traveling rapidly toward Spain.

Why notable:

Multiple witnesses observed the same object.

The cigar shape appears repeatedly in 1950s UFO reports.

🇸🇪 Sweden — Silver sphere with a tail

Date: 13 May 1954
Location: Norrbotten Province
Three witnesses in different areas reported seeing:

a bright silver sphere

with a tail or trail behind it.

🇳🇴 Norway — Three objects flying in formation

Date: 13 May 1954
Location: Northern Norway (near Kautokeino)
Witnesses reported:

three bright objects

flying very fast

in V-formation across the sky.

A deputy constable using binoculars said:

the objects appeared red on one side and white on the other

they seemed to be rotating and were not ordinary airplanes.

🇿🇦 South Africa — “Blood-red star” with strange motion

Date: 16 April 1954
Location: Worcester
A witness saw a red star-like object moving across the sky.

Using a telescope he observed:

smaller moving objects around it

the object moved jerkily, stopping and starting

it climbed rapidly upward

it swayed like a balloon before heading north.

Why this is unusual:

Stop-start motion is not typical for aircraft.

The witness used a telescope, which gave a clearer view.

🇲🇾 British Malaya (today Malaysia) — Harbor workers see cigar UFO

Date: 12 March 1954
Location: Port Swettenham (now Port Klang)
Dock workers observed:

a cigar-shaped flying object

leaving a white trail

slowly disappearing into the clouds.

A second similar sighting was reported in the region days later.
